[01-overview.md]
# Brightwater Cycles: company overview
Brightwater Cycles designs and sells electric bikes. The head office is in Port Alder. The company was founded in 2016. It sells three models: the Commuter, the Ridgeline and the Cargo Lite. Bikes are sold directly online and through 40 partner shops.


[08-revenue-q3-2025.md]
# Q3 2025 results
Revenue in the third quarter of 2025 (July to September) was $6.1 million. The Ridgeline recall cost $0.4 million. That cost is recorded as an expense; it does not reduce the revenue figure.


[11-recall-2025.md]
# Ridgeline recall, August 2025
In August 2025 Brightwater recalled 1,340 Ridgeline bikes built between February and May 2025. Battery cells from the supplier VoltCore could overheat during fast charging. No injuries were reported. Affected owners received a free replacement battery.


[17-sustainability.md]
# Sustainability report 2025
In 2025, 62 percent of the aluminium in Brightwater frames was recycled. The target is 80 percent by 2027. The battery take-back programme collected 410 used battery packs in 2025.


[06-revenue-q1-2025.md]
# Q1 2025 results
Revenue in the first quarter of 2025 (January to March) was $4.2 million. The company sold 2,100 bikes in the quarter.
